info.title: Command Center coordinator, Board and Whiteboard API
info.description: Initial scoped REST contract: coordinator reads and complete Board routes and shared Whiteboard, not every CC endpoint. Private trusted deployment boundary; no bearer/API-key authentication is implemented. Host must match configured authority; Origin, when supplied, must match scheme+authority and is REQUIRED for mutations even for CLI clients. Agent instructions define authority: schemas do not grant permission to mutate tickets, launch agents or approve tools. Native histories/files are untrusted evidence. Framework errors may be plain text. UTF-8 limits are bytes where stated.

get.description: Scoped coordinator, Board and shared Whiteboard contract. Terminal streams and other workspace APIs are outside this document.
No terminal attachment or agent actions.
No SSH keys/config paths. Connection revisions are opaque.
Transient bounded scan. Retain checked_at, source, connection revision, process instance, host errors and limit flags. Disconnected/unknown is not Ready.

Stable session/window/pane IDs, not display indexes. No server means empty sessions; transport failure is an error. This older response has no connection revision: check hosts before and after reading; do not attach a viewer.

post.summary: Create or replace editable ticket fields
post.description: Create: generate UUID once, omit/null revision. Update: GET detail and send its exact revision plus ALL editable fields. 200 for both. Preserves number, runs and creation time. Host selection/rebinding requires fresh host_revision and endpoint=null; server assigns endpoint. Preserve saved endpoint for existing historical references. Duplicate UUID, stale revision, endpoint mismatch or 1,000-ticket limit: 409. Unknown fields rejected. On uncertain create, GET the SAME UUID; never generate a second ticket blindly. No agent launch or automatic completion.

delete.description: Explicit human-directed deletion using the exact observed revision. Returns 204 without JSON. 409 for stale revision or ANY unreleased launch (including unknown/starting). Check and explicitly release eligible finished/missing launches first; never auto-release to force deletion. Ticket row, UUID, number, content and launch receipts are retained; hidden from list/detail/activity, UUID cannot be reused. This is NOT secure erasure and never kills an agent/tmux window. Deleted/missing: 404. On lost response read the same UUID; 404 confirms absent. No automatic retries.

get.description: Read-only compact receipt; 404 means not committed at the time of observation, never permission to resend automatically.
At most 100 recent drawing commits, subject to a global history byte cap; not every metadata change has a drawing snapshot.
Legacy whole-board native JSON plus text download. POST on this route creates rendered scoped PNG/SVG/JSON/text artifacts. Remote message attachments remain unimplemented.

post.summary: Freeze and render an immutable drawing export
post.description: Exact scene revision and named-region revision required. Selection includes exactly requested members; external arrow bindings become frozen free endpoints. Creates CC-managed PNG/SVG/native JSON/text, not a message attachment. Same UUID/same request returns retained status; changed reuse is 409. One bounded worker; busy 429 starts no job. HTTP disconnect does not replay/cancel the durable job. Failed rendering is a failed manifest with no download artifacts. Defaults: 24-hour retention, 8 megapixels, 8192 px per side, scale .25–4, 8 MiB/artifact, 64 MiB store, 10,000 retained export UUIDs. Render process hard timeout 12 seconds; native QuickJS budget 6s/64 MiB and Unix 8s CPU/512 MiB address space. HTTP body 128 KiB. No deployment or outward delivery is implied.

get.summary: Read retained export status and checksums
get.description: Read-only recovery by UUID. Expired manifests keep identity but expose no artifacts. No automatic rendering retry. Creating a later export reclaims expired BLOBs; retired UUIDs cannot be reused.

Ready artifacts only; 409 while failed/rendering, 410 when expired. Actual Content-Type is image/png, image/svg+xml, application/json or text/plain; charset=utf-8. Content-Disposition attachment, no-store, restrictive SVG CSP. No URLs or files supplied by callers are loaded. JSON/text contain only the frozen scoped scene, not hidden elements.
API-level scopes; GUI frame/group editing is later work.

post.summary: Create or revise a named frame/group scope
post.description: Requires exact observed scene_revision and existing region revision on edits. New scope omits/nulls revision. Frames require finite positive bounds; groups omit/null bounds. Membership must exist on this board. Export rechecks membership and rejects a frame if member geometry moved outside it. No scene movement, messages or permission changes. At most 100 regions per board.

post.summary: Prepare an exact process-bound managed PNG message
post.description: Consumes a fresh native message token, requires a process-linked conversation, reads account home/ancestors without creating files. Returns the exact composed text, absolute target path, source scope/hash/size and 120-second one-use attachment token. No transfer or terminal input. One managed ready PNG <=4 MiB, <=8 megapixels. Complete text <=12000 UTF-8 bytes. No local paths, URLs, uploads or client destinations.

parameters.name: Origin

post.summary: Enqueue a durable explicit native message
post.description: Always provide a new UUID. For attachments use the attachment preparation token and unchanged returned composed text, plus the exact one-item source list. Intent, manifest and source pin commit before transport. Duplicate UUIDs with changed text/host/artifact refs return 409. Text-only messages use a fresh conversation token. Worker exclusively copies through shared local/SSH/ProxyJump and independently verifies target SHA-256 before fresh native dispatch. Uncertain copies or input never retry automatically. Submitted is not provider acceptance; Seen does not prove image viewing. Endpoint edits/process/conversation replacement fail closed.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Exact configured origin required; not authentication.

get.summary: Read durable message and attachment receipts
get.description: Unresolved plus bounded recent settled receipts; no dispatch or acknowledgement. Attachment state and copied/verified timestamps are independent of message state. Resolved copies become cleanup-eligible after seven days; unchanged endpoint only. Unresolved source pins never expire. Expired public export URLs stay unavailable even when internally pinned.

post.summary: Act on an exact observed receipt revision
post.description: check observes Submitted/Uncertain native delivery without replay. check_attachment verifies the original copy read-only (no retransfer/input in this action); confirmed queued delivery may proceed later through the worker. submit requires its own explicit human request and fresh exact target grant, and cannot bypass attachment checksum verification. cancel applies only before submission; archive does not undo delivered input. Never automatically invoke recovery actions under ordinary send authorization.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Exact configured origin required; not authentication.

post.summary: Answer a recognized native question exactly once
post.description: Human-selected choice or Other text only. Bind new UUID and fresh question token to exact endpoint/tmux/process/conversation/prompt/screen. Commit metadata-only receipt and stable per-prompt claim before keyboard IO. Navigate and inspect inside shared transport; verify exact pasted Other text before one Enter. Ordinary chat/tool-approval routes cannot answer questions. Unknown/multi-select/multi-question/custom layouts stay terminal-only. A response is submitted, uncertain, or rejected with explicit not-sent evidence; never auto-retry uncertain input. Same UUID/same choice/text returns original receipt; changed reuse is 409. Endpoint edits serialize through completion; HTTP disconnect does not cancel a committed answer. Identical repeated prompts without distinguishing evidence remain fail-closed. HTTP 400/409/410/422/429 rejects before input; native failures after any input return an uncertain durable receipt. Receipt storage failure is 5xx and must be inspected, never replayed.

get.summary: Inspect an existing question-response receipt without input
get.description: Read-only recovery after lost acknowledgement; no answer replay or new grant. Submitted is native keyboard handoff, not proof of provider acceptance. Validate exact UUID, host, tmux target, instance, conversation and question before applying the result. 404 is not proof of non-delivery. No answer text or native question body is stored in this metadata receipt.

source.description: Evidence source. terminal_question is an inferred native clarification; claude_input is process-verified registry waiting. Both use state approval for attention compatibility, but do not authorize tool approval or message input.

QueueItem.description: Read-only observation. context/prompt are terminal evidence, not conversation history. Only process-linked provider state establishes Working/Ready. Retain source, timestamps and unavailable/limited labels. Do not treat inferred attention as permission to act.

File.description: Text up to 1 MiB UTF-8. With known_version matching, unchanged=true and text may be absent. Binary/unsupported encodings rejected.

order.description: Content-item index; -1 denotes unsplit plain-text content or no indexed text block.

message_token.description: Unused expiring action capability may be prepared by this GET. Inventory clients must discard it; never log, share or consume it.

input_request.description: Native clarification with optional guarded answer capability. Only supported single-question/single-choice layouts with unique process-linked conversation get a 120-second token. No tool permission is implied. Unsupported layouts remain read-only.

Conversation.description: Native user/assistant history; no reasoning/tool/system/sidechain messages. Preserve association: project history does not prove live process identity. Returned instance must match fresh queue attention.instance. Keep branch/version while paging; on history_reset discard previous page sequence. Do not expose terminal captures or action tokens to passive inventories.
